recognized_test_commands.command:
/bin/bash -lc 'for backend in git local oci object/s3 object/azblob; do cat > "internal/storage/fs/$backend/close_test.go" <<'"'EOF'
package PLACEHOLDER

import \"testing\"

func TestSnapshotStoreCloseWithoutPolling(t *testing.T) {
 var store SnapshotStore
 if err := store.Close(); err "'!= nil { t.Fatal(err) }
}
EOF
sed -i "s/PLACEHOLDER/$(basename "$backend")/" "internal/storage/fs/$backend/close_test.go"
done
GOPROXY=off go test ./internal/storage/fs/local -run '"'"'^TestSnapshotStoreCloseWithoutPolling$'"' -count=1"

limitations: Shell/script/code-mode edits and tests may not be recognized. A failed invocation can be an environment error. Red/green does not prove the right assertion or test-first. Absence of recognized evidence is not noncompliance. Inspect full events and checkpoint.
